★ Request
Tsuyoshi: Reacts to the sound of fireworks

Ah, there goes another one...♪
Aahh... isn't that nice...

...Yes! I promise!
I promise I'll always be someone you can rely on, Trainer!

Right, right, you've gotta eat when you can!
Besides, as long as you're eating well, you heal much faster.

Ugh... I tried so hard all summer
to make sure I could actually help you, Trainer...
Taaaahhhhhh!

Ah, we're already out of drinks.
Good thing we're at training camp. The one thing we've got mountains of is sports drinks~

Ehehe♪ ...Ah, please let me know right away if you need anything.
I've got your back completely!

Trainer! Wh-Whoa, are you okay?!
...Trainer!!

Wait, they're asleep.
...Fatigue must've really caught up to them.

Suddenly, the distant sound of fireworks begins to echo.
Come to think of it, the second half of the summer festival featured a fireworks show.
Huh...? ...Yes.

...Zzz... zzz.
*mumble*...

Even if we only get to hear the sounds, it'll still make for a funny story—
Ah...!

Because I felt that making any noise
might wake Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi, who was sleeping right by my side.

...Though it was just a dream.
Ugh, we even watched the fireworks together at the shrine, too.

Watching Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi pout with frustration made me chuckle.
Her pure, heartfelt sincerity came through with crystal clarity.

Still... whew. For now, I guess I'll just keep an eye on them.
Trainer... *yawn*. I hope... you get better soon...

Alright, what else can I do for now... let's see.
Ice packs, check. Wet towel, check. Next is—

It seemed Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi had carried me to the training camp's nurse's office.
My head was still feeling hazy.

Alright, let's grab a light bite while we can.
I made some rice porridge, so I'll go heat it up.

Even in sweltering heat that could wilt the summer grass, the Umamusume keep running.
It happened one day in the thick of our summer training camp.

...Hm?
Ah... come to think of it, isn't today the festival...?

No, no, don't worry about it at all!
Though maybe that doesn't sound very convincing coming from someone who collapses all the time, ehehe~

Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's smile brought a strange sense of reassurance.
Trusting her words, I decided to rest for now.
Huh...? ...Wait, does that mean...!
Yahoooooo—*cough*! *hack*! *wheeze*!
You'll rely... on me... from now on...?
Tr-Trainer...!

She must have completely run out of steam after doing everything she possibly could.
I wanted to let my trainee, who had nursed me with all her heart, get some proper rest.

It's Tsuyoshi's special egg porridge! Smells pretty great
with that sesame oil-sautéed chicken and green onions, doesn't it?

You finally, finally told me
that you're 'counting on me,' Trainer~!

I wondered whether that was really something to brag about,
but eating took priority over retorts right now.

If I remember right, there were supposed to be fireworks too...
*yawn*... They said you could see them really well... from the hill...

Things got a bit hectic, but I'm so glad it wasn't anything serious.
I definitely panicked when you collapsed, though...

Ah... Trainer, you shouldn't sit up yet.
Please stay lying down.

Oh, right, Trainer.
Do you feel up to eating anything?

Wh—?! ...Tr-Trainer? ...Are you okay?
You just wobbled, didn't you?

I haven't spent all this time falling sick for nothing!
Porridges are totally my specialty~

A doctor's coming by later just to be safe.
Your symptoms seem pretty mild, but better safe than sorry.

Ehehe, you can actually see them pretty well from here!
There's no crowd either, so it's practically the best seat in the house!
Do you think we can see them...?

Nn... nnh...? ...Huh...? Was I at the shrine...?
What about... the fireworks...?

So... that was all a dream...?
Haaaaah... what a letdown.

I ate the porridge Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi prepared for me.
Its mouthwatering aroma made me forget I was even sick, and my chopsticks didn't stop.
Afterward, in the training camp's courtyard—

Haaah! Whoa, whoa, whoa...
Ahhh, don't run away~?!
Mmmgh... slowly, slowly, don't let the goldfish notice...

Huh...?
Thanks to... my nursing...?

And so, the two of us quietly
spent our time watching the brilliant blooms of fire exploding in the distant night sky.
My vision—wavers.

A momentary dizziness.
At first, I thought it was just the shimmering heat haze, but—

Haaah...! Haaah...! *gasp*...!
Man... this heatwave day after day... really takes a toll...!

Trainer, I brought a fresh wet towel~
Also, the doctor said you should rest up for the rest of the day just to be safe—

When I woke up, night had already fallen, and it was dark outside.
However, I hesitated to sit up. That was—

Um, the ice pack stash is... yep, still good.
Towels are fine too. Since there's still time before the doctor gets here—

Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer!
I'll be your festival escort today!
Phew. I've reported everything to the academy, so that wraps up that part.
